topic: A humorous end of game sequence where Moses Moody shoots a three-pointer while opponents celebrate, gets his own rebound, and shoots again.

hook.first_words: This has to be the funniest way to end a game.
hook.first_frame: A basketball player wearing number 8 in white jersey holding a basketball on the court.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: This has to be the funniest way to end a game.

shots.shows: Player shooting a basket at the end of a game
Moses Moody dribbling and shooting a three-pointer
Opposing players dabbing up while Moody retrieves his rebound
Moody shooting a second three-pointer while Jokic claps

ending.last_frame: Nikola Jokic clapping on the court as Moses Moody prepares/takes his shot.

script: This has to be the funniest way to end a game. You see, Moses Moody brings the ball up the court as the clock is running out. And at this point, the Warriors have already lost the game. But he doesn't care as he shoots a 3 while Westbrook and Gordon are dapping up on the court. And since no one is paying attention, he gets his own miss like he's playing by himself. So Moody says, 'Why not?' and shoots another 3 to cut the lead down to 9. Meanwhile, Jokic is the only one left still paying attention to the game, clapping for Moody.
retention_tricks: Open loop at the start promising the funniest ending
Unusual action on court holding viewer attention
what_makes_it_work: Rare and funny sequence caught live on camera
Good narration highlighting the absurdity of the players not paying attention
Engaging visual payoff with Jokic clapping
